The plan narrows the design's direct `requires` (SR03/07/08/09) to two pages whose closure contains all four names — recorded, no material conflict. No extra `requires` declaration was needed; every dep home is inside the closure.

## Owner decision required (escalation)

`pthm-sr-specified-model-comparison` cannot be stated or proved: the design declares it requires **M20** ("no-experiment-authored; primary-report-queue-retained"), no primary report was read, and the design forbids authoring experiment items until reports are read. The record holds the exact gap and asks the owner either to supply/authorize actual reports plus the analysis layer or to defer the item. No `exp-` item and no invented data exist anywhere in the batch.
